GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and, from a wide barrier, was eased and taken back in the early stages. Over-raced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1 length clear approaching 200m, headed approaching 100m and dropped out sharply # led/weak final 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted outwards and bumped. Raced keenly through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, joined Straightening Up , joint lead 200m, headed 100m, kept on late # led/headed 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards inquired into an incident approaching the 1200m Where the gelding  had to be checked and then shifted out abruptly. It was established that the gelding commenced to over race in the early stages and approaching the 1200m when continuing to over race had to be checked from  heels  before then shifting out, running across heels and blundering. The gelding continued to race fiercely and after being shifted wider near the 1200m was allowed to stride forward to obtain the lead near the 1000m.
